headline: Diana Vreeland and Grace Mirabella: A betrayal on glossy paper
description: 'Sewn and torn' (5/6). Love stories and friendships can sometimes end badly, even in the world of fashion. That is, until 1971, when her loyal assistant dethroned her and ushered in a new era for the magazine.

headline: Environmental amnesia: How we can't even remember the lost biodiversity of yore
description: While we can recall car windshields covered with dead insects after a drive, what do we know about wolves that once roamed the countryside in the Middle Ages, or salmon swimming in the Seine in the 19th century?
